title: National Artist Nune Alvarado brings stories of ordinary Filipinos to Art Elaan

blocks.text: Art lovers and painting enthusiasts are in for a a treat as the works of newly proclaimed National Artist for Visual Arts Nunelucio “Nune” Alvarado are set to be exhibited at Art Elaan at Ayala Malls Manila Bay from November 20 to December 15.
